items.goal: add inline self-monitor hook in `src/cerebellum/orchestrator.ts` runWaypoint iteration loop that fires every 3 tool calls. The hook appends a brief observation message to the conversation (NOT an abort, just a nudge) asking the agent to notice patterns like 'am I repeating?' or 'did I misread the goal?'. This addresses the 'reflection is triggered, not continuous' gap — currently self-awareness only runs in dream phase, never during wakeful execution. Sacred-file change — requires manual review.

Curiosity-mode reads self-model.md aspirations and generates 'explore X' / 'try Y' style backlog items that are NOT fixes to existing problems — they are capability expansions. Add new origin 'curiosity' to BacklogOrigin in `src/orchestrator/events.ts` and route curiosity-seeded items to pending-review like dreams. This closes the 'all goals are borrowed' gap by giving the agent a third goal source beyond user and dream.
